description: This file contains functions and types for checking and ensuring the presence and correct version of the 'acpx' CLI tool, including installation logic and version validation.

methods.name: extractVersion
methods.description: Extracts semantic version string from stdout and stderr output.

methods.name: isExpectedVersionConfigured
methods.description: Checks if a version string is non-empty and valid.

methods.name: supportsPathResolution
methods.description: Determines if a command string supports path resolution based on its format.

methods.name: isUnsupportedVersionProbe
methods.description: Detects if the output indicates an unsupported version probe.

methods.name: resolveVersionFromPackage
methods.description: Resolves the version of 'acpx' from package.json by walking up the directory tree.

methods.name: resolveVersionCheckResult
methods.description: Compares installed and expected versions to determine success or mismatch.

methods.name: checkAcpxVersion
methods.description: Checks the installed version of 'acpx', optionally installs if missing or mismatched.

methods.name: ensureAcpx
methods.description: Ensures that the 'acpx' CLI tool is installed and matches the expected version, installing if necessary.
